scripts.start: concurrently -k "tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.cjs -i src/styles.css -o public/admin.css --watch" "webpack serve --config webpack.config.js --mode development"
scripts.build: webpack --config webpack.config.js --mode production && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.cjs -i src/styles.css -o dist/admin.css --minify
